posts.linkedin:
Finding local leads on Google Maps wastes valuable morning time.

Freelancers and agencies often spend hours scrolling through maps instead of reaching out to prospects.

I can provide a simple spreadsheet that pulls local businesses from Google Places, showing phone numbers, email when available, review counts and whether a website exists, including newly opened shops.

You can start the day by messaging the list rather than building it, giving you more time for pitches and meetings.

DM me with the word LEADS and tell me what you sell; I will check if the sheet fits your needs and you pay only after you approve the work.

replies.reply: Hi, thanks for messaging. I build simple lead sheets of local businesses from Google Places so freelancers can pitch sooner, whatever they sell. Quick question: what do you want customers to do when you reach out—call, WhatsApp, email or book a meeting?

replies.if_they_say: do you do this for my kind of business?
replies.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out. The sheet covers local businesses found through Google Places with contact details, review counts and website checks, including newly opened ones. It is not tied to one profession. What service do you offer to local businesses?

Of course. I can send a one-page summary: what is included, timeline and how it works. Is the hesitation budget, timing, or whether it will actually bring enquiries? You pay only after you approve the work, so there is no big upfront commitment.

alts: Search-first versus pitch-first: three signs to check
Slide 2 of 7: Hours lost scrolling Google Maps for leads. You open Maps, scroll listings, copy details, and the morning ends before one message is sent.
Slide 3 of 7: Irrelevant leads waste billable time. Many listings are closed, wrong category, or have no website, so you chase dead ends instead of clients.
Slide 4 of 7: Start with a pre-qualified list. A daily sheet lists local businesses found through Google Places, with contact details, review counts and website checks, including newly opened ones.
Slide 5 of 7: Pitch first, build momentum early. With names and details ready, you can message businesses before your day fills up and start real conversations.
Slide 6 of 7: Spend your morning pitching, not searching. The sheet helps you skip manual searching so you reach out to relevant local businesses and focus on your service.
Slide 7 of 7: DM LEADS. Message us for an honest conversation about whether this lead sheet fits your service.
